create_named_dimensions: create a Dimensions object mapping named letters like B, T, N to integer sizes
lookup_shape_by_key: lookup a shape tuple from a Dimensions object using a string key like dims['NBT']
compute_flat_size: compute the flat product size of named dimensions using dims.size('BT')
flatten_axes_with_parens: flatten multiple axes into one by wrapping them in parentheses like dims['(BT)N']
set_dimensions_from_shape: set dimension sizes from an array shape by assigning dims['XY'] = array.shape
